Dan.10.1-Dan.12.13 continuous final revelation parent across chapter seams.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew court-entry narrative: conquest frame, selection, curriculum, ration, and renaming
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dated siege and vessel transfer open the book; royal selection commands and the four Judean/assigned-name catalogue form one intake movement before Dan.1.8.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split conquest, criteria, rations, and names, or attach Dan.1.8 merely because food appears in Dan.1.5.
proposed_chunks.risk: Names, titles, chronology, and Dan.1.4 qere/ketiv can be turned into identity, etymology, history, or source rulings.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hebrew ויהי opens the dated frame. Local UXLC/OSHB marks Dan.1.4 ketiv מאום versus qere מום; this is evidence only, not a preferred vocalization or boundary.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew request-and-test scene
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dan.1.8 adversatively initiates resolve, request, objection, ten-day counterproposal, test, inspection, and changed ration.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate Dan.1.8 as a proof text or divide dialogue from test result.
proposed_chunks.risk: ויתשם על־לבו and יתגאל plus food practice can smuggle ethical or ritual rulings.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated test, ten-day, and inspection diction encloses a request-result scene; lexical range cannot decide dietary law, motive, ethics, or miracle.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew commissioning, royal examination, and temporal coda
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dan.1.17 resets to gifts and competence; appointed-time presentation, examination, standing, and Cyrus coda close the tale.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.1.21 as chronology or merge the outcome into the next dream crisis.
proposed_chunks.risk: Dan.1.21 invites chronology/historicity harmonization.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The four-youth subject reset and קץ הימים presentation formula form a closure; עד שנת אחת לכורש is a narrative horizon, not permission to harmonize dates.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Dream crisis and lethal decree crossing the Hebrew-to-Aramaic seam
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dated dream disturbance triggers summons, escalating demand, impossibility claim, and decree reaching Daniel.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Create a boundary inside Dan.2.4 or split every repeated exchange.
proposed_chunks.risk: The in-verse language switch, rare Aramaic, titles, qere/ketiv, and date invite source, author, or chronology claims.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hebrew continues through the cue ארמית in Dan.2.4; Aramaic direct speech begins within that verse and continues through Dan.7.28. Verse coordinates keep Dan.2.4 whole. UXLC/OSHB marks Dan.2.9 הזמנתון qere/ketiv pressure without selecting a reading.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic counteraction, communal petition, night revelation, and hymn
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Daniel's answer to Arioch begins rescue; consultation and petition lead to revelation and the embedded blessing.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.2.20-23 from the petition and revelation.
proposed_chunks.risk: Rare Aramaic and revelation language can become theology or miracle authority.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aramaic טעם and רז bind decree, mystery, revelation, and response; morphology supports cohesion only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic royal approach and interpretation preface
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Daniel returns through Arioch; royal question and Daniel's disclaimer frame the report beginning Dan.2.31.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge the approach with the hymn or sever the disclaimer from the audience.
proposed_chunks.risk: Court titles and אחרית יומיא invite office, chronology, or fulfillment claims.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated רז and הודע plus audience formulas create a preface; latter-days wording remains in context and authorizes no schedule.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic symbolic dream report
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: You, O king, were seeing opens the image; materials, stone strike, dissolution, and mountain complete the report.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize every metal, body part, stone, or mountain.
proposed_chunks.risk: Symbol and kingdom mapping can be smuggled into structure.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aramaic חזית and cumulative material/body terms form one register; lexemes identify no kingdom.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic dream interpretation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: This is the dream and its interpretation explicitly turns from report to ordered correspondences ending in assurance.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.2.44-45 or split every interpreted material.
proposed_chunks.risk: Kingdoms, stone, chronology, fulfillment, and sovereignty are hot zones.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The demonstrative plus פשר transition and closing assurance cohere; Aramaic kingdom diction selects no historical identity or theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic royal response, elevation, and appointments
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Royal embodied response begins outcome; confession, gifts, office, request, and companion appointments close the episode.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach outcome to interpretation or isolate homage as doctrine.
proposed_chunks.risk: Worship/offering terms, divine titles, and offices create translation and theology pressure.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Aramaic אדין and appointment language close the arc; lexical range does not decide worship or theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic image dedication, official assembly, decree, and compliance
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Construction and dedication summon officials; herald command, repeated instruments, sanction, and compliance form one scene.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split official ranks or instrument lists.
proposed_chunks.risk: Loanwords, instrument spellings, qere/ketiv, and Greek-addition numbering can become date, source, or canon claims.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repetition of צלם and official/instrument catalogues is rhetorical. OSHB/UXLC records instrument spelling pressure. Greek additions lie outside these coordinates without canon or witness preference.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic accusation, interrogation, threat, and refusal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Accusatory formula opens conflict; charge, summons, offer/threat, and bounded answer culminate at Dan.3.18.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.3.17-18 or split accusation from interrogation.
proposed_chunks.risk: Conditional syntax and deliverance language can decide ethics, miracle, or theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: אכלו קרציהון and הן איתי are read inside the exchange; syntax is evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic furnace ordeal, astonishment, release, and inspection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Changed royal expression starts action; binding, casting, reversal, fourth-figure report, summons, exit, and inspection complete the ordeal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate the fourth figure, release, or inspection as identity or miracle units.
proposed_chunks.risk: Fourth-figure description, garments, deliverance, and versions create identity and historicity pressure.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: דמה לבר־אלהין is reported royal language with indefinite/plural/idiomatic pressure; no angelic/divine identity or miracle ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic acclamation, coercive decree, and promotion coda
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Royal response to inspection yields blessing and decree; promotion closes the tale.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge decree into ordeal or isolate violence from the closing response.
proposed_chunks.risk: Messenger terminology, coercion, and confession invite identity, ethics, or theology authority.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Decree formulae bind acclamation, sanction, and outcome; מלאכה does not establish messenger identity.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic royal epistolary address and hymnic thesis
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: King-to-peoples salutation, peace, purpose, and praise establish proclamation before first-person narrative.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach it to chapter 3 or isolate each praise line.
proposed_chunks.risk: Numbering differs across traditions and royal theology can be made authoritative.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The address עבד לכל־עממיא and שלמכון ישגא creates a document opening; no numbering or version preference.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic first-person dream setting and tree-watcher report
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Royal repose/fear resets narrative; failed specialists, Daniel, tree, watcher decree, and interpretation request form one report.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split tree, watcher speech, or seven-times formula.
proposed_chunks.risk: Holy-gods wording, watcher identity, mental state, time formula, and versional order/wording are hot zones.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: חזוי ראשי, אילן, עיר וקדיש, and quoted decree cohere. רוח אלהין קדישין and עדן שבעה remain translation-sensitive.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic interpreter reaction, interpretation, and counsel
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Daniel's astonishment turns report to response; explicit tree identification proceeds through counsel.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.4.27 as an ethical or soteriological rule.
proposed_chunks.risk: פרק, righteousness/mercy, diagnosis, and seven-times language can smuggle doctrine or chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: פשרה, אנתה־הוא אילנא, and לכן מלכא mark interpretation and counsel; morphology settles no doctrine.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic reported realization and abasement
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: All this came begins realization; twelve-month transition, boast, voice, immediate outcome, and time completion form one movement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split heavenly voice or bodily description.
proposed_chunks.risk: Person shifts, body/mind descriptions, miracle/historicity, and versional order are unresolved.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: כולא מטא, עוד מלתא בפם מלכא, and בה־שעתא organize realization; rare diction is translation evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic restoration, praise, and closure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: At the end of the days the first-person voice resumes; reason, honor, kingdom, counselors, and praise return.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate doxology from restoration or attach it to the next tale.
proposed_chunks.risk: Theological assertions and historicity can be promoted beyond form evidence.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ול־קצת יומיא and restored first-person verbs frame closure; divine titles are not theology authority.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic feast, hand-writing apparition, and court crisis
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: New king and feast reset scene; vessel command, praise catalogue, writing, bodily reaction, summons, reward, and failure culminate in confusion.

proposed_chunks.risk: Royal identity, vessel chronology, anatomy idioms, miracle/historicity, and versional variation.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic queen's counsel and Daniel's summons
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The queen enters, identifies Daniel by a title/capability recital, and prompts summons and reward offer.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic refusal, retrospective accusation, inscription, and interpretation

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic investiture, death reversal, and reign transition
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Promised honor is ordered, followed by same-night reversal and new ruler.

proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: בה־ליליא and וקבל מלכותא form a compact coda; no Darius identification, reign harmonization, or numbering preference.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic appointment, conspiracy, and decree
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Appointments and Daniel's distinction provoke investigation, consultation, and a sealed thirty-day decree.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split officials, conspiracy, or law formulas.
proposed_chunks.risk: Administrative titles, empire/Darius identity, law, and versions can become historical reconstruction.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Appointment and כל־קבל דנה causal formulas bind elevation to conspiracy; titles are discourse evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic prayer, accusation, royal struggle, and sealing in the den
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Knowledge of the writing leads to established prayer; discovery, accusation, rescue attempt, and stone/seal close peril.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.6.10 or split accusation from den commitment.
proposed_chunks.risk: Prayer practice, law, miracle expectation, names, and qere/ketiv can become ritual or history authority.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: די ידע די רשים כתבא and decree/den repetition cohere; prayer wording is context evidence, not universal ritual law.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic vigil, den inquiry, deliverance, inspection, and reversal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Sleepless night leads to dawn inquiry; answer, messenger report, extraction, inspection, and accuser reversal complete ordeal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate messenger identity, miracle, or violent reversal.
proposed_chunks.risk: Messenger identity, miracle/historicity, innocence, family punishment, and violence ethics.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Dawn/haste and answer formulas bind the movement; מלאכה does not establish identity.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic universal decree, confession, and prosperity coda
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: King addresses all peoples; decree and poetic predicates lead to the reign summary.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach confession as doctrine or isolate prosperity chronology.
proposed_chunks.risk: Divine predicates and reign names invite theology and chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Address/decree formulas and ודניאל דנה הצלח create a coda; form evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic dated vision of sea, beasts, and horn
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dated superscription resets genre; sea, four beasts, and focused horn observation form opening tableau.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each beast, horn, eye, or mouth.
proposed_chunks.risk: Symbol identities, number/gender qere pressure, versions, and chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: חזה הוית, fourfold sequencing, and משתכל הוית organize the tableau; morphology identifies no symbol.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic throne-court and human-like arrival
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Thrones are set and court sits; fire/books, beast outcome, cloud-borne human-like arrival, approach, and dominion form one scene.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.7.13-14 or separate beast outcome.
proposed_chunks.risk: Ancient of Days, כבר אנש, clouds, פלח, and dominion are identity/theology hot zones.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: כבר אנש is a comparison phrase in the vision and פלח has service/cultic pressure; no figure identity or theology ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic distress, inquiry, initial interpretation, and recap
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Distress prompts approach and request; brief interpretation is followed by focused inquiry and recap through judgment reversal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: End at Dan.7.18 or detach the fourth-beast inquiry.
proposed_chunks.risk: Saints, horn, court, and possession language can force communal or historical identities.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: קרבת על־חד מן־קאמיא and בעא mark inquiry; repeated fourth-beast/horn terms bind recap; plurals settle no referent.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Aramaic expanded interpretation, time formula, reversal, and closure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Thus he said expands the fourth-beast explanation; עד־כה סופא די־מלתא explicitly closes vision and Aramaic section.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.7.25 or Dan.7.27 as prediction/theology chunks.
proposed_chunks.risk: Kings, law/time change, עדן ועדנין ופלג עדן, saints, dominion, chronology, and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The compressed time formula remains translation-sensitive; no duration, identity, history, or eschatology ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew ram-goat vision and duration question
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: New superscription and Hebrew return open the vision; location, animals/horns, sanctuary/continual pressure, speaker question, and number form tableau.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Treat Hebrew return as source proof, split horns, or isolate Dan.8.14.
proposed_chunks.risk: Language, symbol identities, התמיד, rare פלמוני, evening-morning number, Qumran/versions, and chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hebrew resumes after Dan.7.28. Repeated ראיתי/והנה binds vision; התמיד and פלמוני are translation-sensitive and the number is not converted to a schedule.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew interpretation commission, explanation, sealing, and collapse
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Daniel seeks understanding; commission, explanation, sealing, collapse, and return to duty form one response.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split named symbols or detach sealing/aftermath.
proposed_chunks.risk: Gabriel, human-like figure, kings, time of end, fulfillment, chronology, and translation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: בינה/הבן and interpretation discourse bind unit; named symbols within explanation do not authorize historical identity.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew dated scripture-reading and prayer orientation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Regnal superscription and reading reset scene; perceived seventy-year word leads to prayer, fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach seventy years for calculation or lose the reading-prayer hinge.
proposed_chunks.risk: Darius, Jeremiah relation, years, books, chronology, and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: בינותי בספרים and נתתי את־פני make the hinge; the internal Jeremiah relation does not harmonize chronology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew confession and petition
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Prayer opens with address/confession, cycles communal sin and divine righteousness/compassion, recalls warning and exodus, then intensifies imperatives.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split every turn or isolate Dan.9.19.
proposed_chunks.risk: Covenant/Torah, culpability, divine attributes, and history can become theology or ethics authority.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person plurals, לך/ולנו contrasts, and שמע/סלחה/הקשיבה/עשה bind prayer; rhetoric is not theology authority.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew prayer interruption and seventy-sevens disclosure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: While-praying clauses introduce Gabriel and instruction; the compressed seventy-sevens discourse continues through covenant/desolation closure.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.9.24-27, split numbers, or impose punctuation/chronology.
proposed_chunks.risk: שבעים שבעים, משיח, נחתך, antecedents, covenant subject, כנף שקוצים משומם, Greek versions, chronology, identity, and fulfillment.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew final-revelation superscription, mourning, apparition, and collapse
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Cyrus-year heading states revealed word and understanding; mourning leads to river apparition, companions' reaction, and collapse.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split body catalogue or make chapter 10 independent of 11-12.
proposed_chunks.risk: Dating, conflict rendering, location, apparition identity, and chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ובינה לו במראה anticipates continuous explanation; והנה איש אחד opens encounter but does not identify the figure.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew strengthening dialogue and disclosure preface
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A hand raises Daniel; hearing/delay explanation and repeated strengthening lead to writing-of-truth disclosure.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split touches or prince/Michael references, or end at the chapter seam.
proposed_chunks.risk: Messenger, Persian/Greek princes, Michael, rare syntax, spiritual identity, chronology, and theology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated נגע/חזק and אל־תירא organize encounter; שר and מיכאל are reported titles/names and settle no ontology or history.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew north-south succession/conflict register, first movement
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The messenger continues and announces truth; arise, north/south, return, and fall formulas run to the brief tax-exactor successor.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Make each ruler, marriage, campaign, or fortress a chunk.
proposed_chunks.risk: Antecedents, identities, history, chronology, rare syntax, variants, and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ועתה אמת אגיד לך continues Dan.10.21; יעמד and directional ruler formulas make a register while referents remain unresolved.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew contemptible successor, alliances, campaigns, sanctuary violation, and maskilim ordeal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: In his place a contemptible one resets the subject; deceit, campaigns, covenant/sanctuary violation, and wise-teacher ordeal continue to appointed-time closure.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.11.31 or maskilim verses.
proposed_chunks.risk: Identity, covenant prince, Kittim, התמיד, השקוץ משומם, המשכילים, violence, chronology, history, and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ועמד על־כנו נבזה resets subject; במועד and covenant terms bind movement. Hot phrases stay in context without identity or schedule.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew self-exalting king, end-time conflict, and unaided end
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The king will do according to his will marks a debated subject transition; exaltation, fortress cult, conflict sweep, alarm, and end form one movement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Force ruler continuity/discontinuity or split regions and campaigns.
proposed_chunks.risk: Subject identity, חמדת נשים, אלוה מעזים, geography, end time, history, eschatology, chronology, and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ועשה כרצונו המלך is real discourse pressure but does not settle referent; חמדת נשים and אלוה מעזים remain translation hot zones.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew culmination, awakening contrast, wise radiance, and sealing
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: At that time continues revelation; distress, book/deliverance, awakening contrast, maskilim, and sealing command complete outcome.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach Dan.12.2-3 as doctrine or sever seal command.
proposed_chunks.risk: Michael, book, רבים מישני אדמת־עפר, עולם, resurrection, soteriology, maskilim, and eschatology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: ובעת ההיא links Dan.11; compressed רבים מישני אדמת־עפר and עולם contrasts remain translation hot zones; no resurrection or theology ruling.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Hebrew riverside epilogue with questions, oath, numbers, and dismissal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Daniel sees two others; how-long and outcome questions receive oath, refinement, 1290/1335 sayings, and final dismissal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each number, identify speakers beyond text, or detach Dan.12.13.
proposed_chunks.risk: Speaker identity, מועד מועדים וחצי, התמיד, שקוץ שמם, numbers, maskilim, rest/stand, chronology, resurrection, and eschatology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: עד־מתי and מה אחרית structure two rounds. Time formulas and תנוח ותעמד לגרלך remain in context without schedule, doctrine, or preferred rendering.
